items.subtitle: Merged v26 editor features with v28 runtime features
items.contents:
Feature Merge

Merged the v26 editor History, multi-selection and Scene State features with the v28 runtime, rendering, collision events and Node Index features.

Merged the v26 and v28 ScriptNode definitions, including saveState, loadState, removeState, clearState and onCollideWith.

Merged the Help documentation from both branches.

items.subtitle: Runtime objects render again
items.contents:
Runtime rendering fix

Fixed a runtime cache initialization bug that caused the optimized renderer to see an empty node list when a game started. Runtime nodes are now discovered before the cache is populated, so scene objects render normally while the v25-v27 optimization system remains active.

items.subtitle: Runtime rendering restored
items.contents:
Runtime rendering restored

Runtime rendering was restored to the known-good v24 rendering path while keeping the later runtime caches and optimization work. The renderer again uses the normal 2D canvas context path, while cached render ordering and visibility culling remain active.

items.subtitle: Updates viewer
items.contents:
Updates viewer

The version shown on the Node2D creation screen is now clickable. It opens this searchable version history using the same navigation style as Help.

items.subtitle: Debug Output
items.contents:
Debug Output

Debug runtime gained an Output panel for logs, warnings, errors, ScriptNode exceptions, JavaScript errors, and unhandled promise rejections.

items.subtitle: Runtime input fixes
items.contents:
Runtime input

Restored runtime pointer, touch, mouse, screen input, joystick helpers, and the runtime projection used by those systems.

items.subtitle: Help references
items.contents:
Help references

Help documentation was expanded with recent ScriptNode, collision, object lifecycle, audio, AI, optimization, and runtime documentation.

items.subtitle: Runtime optimization
items.contents:
Runtime optimization

Runtime gained cached node/body/script lookups, cached render ordering, render culling, batched spawn startup work, faster cloning, collision broadphase improvements, and more aggressive cleanup when objects are destroyed.

items.subtitle: Destroy Object cleanup
items.contents:
Destroy Object cleanup

Destroy Object now removes runtime scene data, bodies, ScriptNodes, timers, routes, references, and lookup entries so destroyed objects no longer remain reachable through the runtime caches.

items.subtitle: Collision updates
items.contents:
Collision updates

Added optimized onCollideWith behavior and improved runtime collision processing.

items.subtitle: Node Index
items.contents:
Node Index

Nodes gained an Index that controls draw order. The Node context menu gained Move Up and Move Down controls.

items.subtitle: Runtime duplicates
items.contents:
Runtime duplicates

Duplicated runtime objects keep their original scripts and connections with unique runtime IDs and remapped ScriptNode connections.

items.subtitle: Audio volume and low-latency playback
items.contents:
Audio

playAudio gained volume and improved playback caching using Web Audio where available. Existing start, duration, loop, and fade controls remain supported.

items.subtitle: Follow, Chase, and Avoid
items.contents:
Movement AI

Follow Object gained Speed. Chase and Avoid gained map-based obstacle handling and physics-driven movement.

items.subtitle: Create Object Angle
items.contents:
Create Object Angle

Create Object gained an Angle input so a spawned object can start with a chosen rotation before velocity is applied.

items.subtitle: Version display
items.contents:
Version display

The Node2D creation screen reads the displayed version from manifest.json.

items.subtitle: A* Chase paths
items.contents:
Chase pathfinding

Chase changed from local steering to actual A* pathfinding across a map built from collider obstacles, with replanning for moving targets.

items.subtitle: Script viewport memory
items.contents:
Script viewport memory

Each ScriptNode remembers its Script editor pan and zoom position.

items.subtitle: Sliding numeric inputs
items.contents:
Sliding numeric inputs

Swipe numeric ScriptNode inputs left or right to decrease or increase by a step derived from the current value.

items.subtitle: Follow Object
items.contents:
Follow Object

Follow Object moves the current Physics node directly toward a target using its configured Speed and rotates toward movement unless rotation is fixed.

items.subtitle: Chase and Avoid
items.contents:
Chase and Avoid

Added Map, Target, and Speed controls for physics-based target movement using collider obstacles from a selected folder.
